content: The rockslide at (11,4) is gone — the corridor is clear. Path: from (5,7) go east to x=11, north through the gap at (11,3), up to (11,1). Then interact with the chest.

args.approach: Rockslide is cleared (pass open). Walk east to x=11, north through the gap at (11,3) to the shrine chest at (11,1), and open it.
